Home / Verified Talent

Verified engineering talent,
backed by technical assessment.

A structured record of what has been verified about a professional, how, and when.

Methodology

Six layers of verification.

Each layer is recorded separately with a date, so you can see exactly what has been assessed.

01

Experience verification

Employment history and project exposure reviewed against what the candidate claims.

02

Software assessment

Proficiency tested in the tools the role needs: Revit, Navisworks, ACC, Civil 3D and others.

03

Technical interview

Discipline-specific questions with an engineer, covering standards, LOD and coordination judgement.

04

Practical BIM test

A time-boxed exercise reproducing a realistic modelling or coordination task.

05

Portfolio verification

Work samples reviewed where the candidate and former employers authorise it.

06

Communication & standards

English communication and knowledge of BIM execution and information standards.

What you see

A profile with its evidence.

A keyword-matched CV

What you usually get

  • Software listed, not tested
  • No record of what was checked
  • No explanation of fit

An ENGISOFT profile

What you get instead

  • Role-specific technical assessment
  • Timestamped verification records
  • Anonymised until you request an interview

Shortlists

Explainable matching

  • Why each profile matched your requirement
  • Mandatory and preferred criteria separated
  • Missing skills listed openly

This reflects ENGISOFT’s internal assessment framework. It does not imply Autodesk certification or any external accreditation.
